decisions.reason: Limiting the delivered colour variants to full-colour, black, and white does not change the requirement to provide all file types needed for digital and hard-copy use.
The source selects which colour versions to deliver but does not change the selected rev4-02 design or its primary colour arrangement.
The colour-variant decision does not alter the completed concept and revision process.

In the immediately preceding question, the three options refer to standard logo colour versions, not to the brand colour details or codes; the separate documentation clarification is already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
